subject.title: [Bug]: TTS elevenlabs provider generates audio but OpenClaw plays OpenAI voice instead

question: Should auto TTS keep the documented multi-provider fallback default when the configured provider fails or is skipped, or should a configured provider be sticky and fail loudly instead of playing a fallback voice?
rationale: Both behaviors are plausible: fallback preserves availability and matches current docs/tests, while stickiness avoids surprising provider changes and possible paid-provider confusion.

options.title: Keep fallback default, add strict path
options.body: Preserve current documented fallback behavior for upgrades, but add or reuse a clear strict-provider path for users who require ElevenLabs-only playback.

options.title: Make configured provider sticky by default
options.body: Change auto TTS so messages.tts.provider failure stops playback instead of using another provider, with release notes and regression coverage for the behavior change.

options.title: Keep diagnostics-only behavior
options.body: Leave fallback semantics unchanged and close future requests as expected behavior once docs/status messaging are judged sufficient.

recommendation.title: Keep fallback default, add strict path
recommendation.body: Preserve current documented fallback behavior for upgrades, but add or reuse a clear strict-provider path for users who require ElevenLabs-only playback.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across core TTS, fallback provider behavior, and speech provider registration, so this product-policy call routes there best.
